Helicopter Crashes in Los Angeles, Killing Three

A news helicopter crashed in the San Fernando Valley area of Los Angeles on Tuesday, resulting in the deaths of at least three people. The incident occurred in Chatsworth, near the site of an earlier fatal SUV-bus collision. Footage from inside the aircraft captured moments before the crash. The helicopter belonged to NBC4 Los Angeles. Firefighters responded to the scene, where the aircraft crashed into a parking lot near commercial buildings. One person was taken to the hospital with unknown injuries.
